title: The Pale Smile Again
author: Theo Thornbury
blurb: Bram Okonkwo, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
